about.title: Andaman Asset Solution
about.subtitle: A Phuket developer working at deliberately small scale.

story.title: Built by people who live here
story.body:
Andaman Asset Solution began with a straightforward observation: the best plots in Phuket were being bought by people who had never stood on them in the rain.

We started acquiring land the slow way — walking it, watching where the water goes in October, checking what the neighbouring title actually permits. Only then did we start building. That order has not changed since, and it is the reason our project list is short.

Today we develop, sell and look after a small number of villa communities on the island's west coast. The same people who negotiated the land are still the ones answering the phone after handover.

quality.title: Build it once
quality.body: Specification is set at design stage and not value-engineered afterwards. What is in the contract is what gets poured.

transparency.title: Show the work
transparency.body: Monthly site photography, published whether the month went well or not. Buyers overseas should not have to take our word for it.

longTerm.title: Stay for the long term
longTerm.body: We hold units in our own developments. Our interests and our owners' interests point the same way.
